scenes.name: 04 母舰终结
scenes.shotNote: 主角机甲跃到桥面最高点，炮艇和无人机群从两侧压出，远处敌方母舰与裂隙同框，最后一击引爆整个天际线，作为战役收尾镜头。

layers.shapeDesc: hero mech on elevated strike point
layers.look: hero mech in premium final silhouette, blazing spear, polished damage, bright back edge highlights
layers.notes:
role:hero_finisher
action:raising spear for final strike
layers.externalPrompt: Final hero pose with premium readability, clean silhouette separation, and decisive focus hierarchy.

layers.look: escort trooper framed by sparks, rifle pointed upward, disciplined posture
layers.notes:
role:left_formation
state:holding line for the finale
layers.externalPrompt: The left escort remains crisp and readable without competing with the hero mech.

layers.look: right escort with red tactical lights, rifle angled toward the carrier, sparks around boots
layers.notes:
role:right_formation
state:covering the hero's strike angle
layers.externalPrompt: The right escort should help frame the hero, not become a second lead.

layers.look: heavy shield unit kneeling behind the hero, bright barrier edge, soot and dust
layers.externalPrompt: The heavy unit functions as a grounded base element under the final attack composition.

layers.look: formation of attack drones creating a curved escort frame with bright engine pinpoints
layers.notes:
role:escort_arc
state:framing the upper left composition
layers.externalPrompt: The drone pack should act like a compositional accent line with readable tech silhouettes.

layers.look: gunship crossing the right sky lane, engine bloom, missile racks, premium military finish
layers.notes:
role:right_sky_support
state:converging with the hero strike
layers.externalPrompt: The gunship should read as a polished support element converging into the climax.

layers.look: wreck pieces and burning fragments drifting in the lower battlefield layer
layers.externalPrompt: Only use the wreckage as lower-layer depth and war residue.

layers.look: stabilized battle breach, giant circular energy ring, blue core and molten rim, cosmic depth
layers.notes:
role:mythic_backdrop
state:aligned with final battlefield skyline
layers.externalPrompt: The breach should echo the carrier shape and amplify the mythic scale of the finale.

layers.look: black fortress-carrier, red hull cuts, shield fracture, giant ventral engines and artillery ridge
layers.externalPrompt: The enemy carrier must feel enormous, premium, and immediately legible as the final target.
